verdicts.reason: Both just shrink the centered vertical stack into the wide banner instead of rearranging it left to right, which leaves large empty side areas. The CTA sits only about 12px above the bottom edge in both. A's bigger headline crowds the top edge, and its subline is jammed between headline and CTA. B's slightly smaller headline gives the stack a little more breathing room, though the tiny subline is borderline readable in both.
